pilot.selection_bias_explanation: The internal headline compared users the agent chose to serve with everyone else. Served users were selected by the agent and were already more likely to succeed. The randomized comparison keeps every treatment-arm user in the treatment denominator, including those never served, and compares that group with the holdout arm.
